{{Conjecture}}

A study performed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in its first several months focused on [[Cephalon|Cephalons]]. The study involved Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified Inquisitor (Cephalon)|Inquisitor]]. The study found that the four-dimensional beings had at least nine emotional states, possibly more, with three of them being only faintly close to emotions experienced by other [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Rumor had it that the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] on the study had gone mad while trying to wrap his head around the varying states of the Cephalons four-dimensional consciousness.<ref name="CNII:SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
